decision: Do not enable indoor navigation until legal floor-plan data, room and POI inventory, entrances, vertical connectors, inaccessible/private-area markings, confidence scores, and manual QA notes exist for at least one building.
uiSummary: Needs legal floor plans, rooms, entrances, connectors, access boundaries, confidence scores, and QA notes
restrictions: Do not include restricted, staff-only, security-sensitive, or private areas unless explicitly permitted.
Do not claim emergency evacuation routing.
Do not present indoor routes as safety instructions.
Do not infer accessible routes without validating lifts, ramps, and step-free paths.
Do not assume floor numbering is consistent across buildings.
qaRequirements: visual floor check against the legal source
entrance alignment against the outdoor map
known missing corridor, room, and connector notes
